question: When does jim propose to pam on the office?
text: Jim proposes to Pam near the end of **“Weight Loss,” the Season 5 premiere** of *The Office*. He gets down on one knee in the rain at a gas station rest stop. The two-part premiere originally aired on **September 25, 2008**; if your streaming service splits it up, the proposal is in **Part 2**. ([youtube.com](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=N56tjXt6JoY&utm_source=openai))
